
=================================================================
#89 Anseung  (670 June)
Arc: Silla-Tang War · place: pyongyang · tone: exile court drama
Logline: Geom Mojam raises Goguryeo’s flag and finds a royal to stand under it. They disagree about dying, and only one of them sees the morning.
=================================================================
[0] ── SCENE: The Protectorate ──
[1] ¶ Every revival needs two things: a flag and a royal. Geom Mojam has the flag.
[2] ¶ The empire has done it again on the Taedong. Pyongyang is a Protectorate now, run by Tang clerks who seem surprised that anyone minds. Mojam minds. He kills the clerks, raises Goguryeo’s colours, and goes looking for someone royal to stand under them.
[3] ¶ He finds one on an island in the western sea, mending a net. His name is Anseung. His father is Yeon Jungto, the uncle who took twelve cities over to Silla. His mother was a king’s daughter. Mojam only needs the second half.
[4] ❝QUOTE (Samguk Sagi (三國史記) bk. 6, Silla Annals — King Munmu, yr. 10 (670), sixth month): Mojam, a daehyeong of Goguryeo from Surim Fortress, gathered the surviving people, marched from Gungmo Fortress to south of the Pae River, and killed the Tang officials and the monk Beop'an. Heading for Silla, he reached Saya Island in the western sea, found Anseung, son of the Goguryeo minister Yeon Jungto, brought him into the River Palace, and set him up as lord.❞
[5] ── SCENE: The River Camp ──
[6] ¶ By the next spring the revival has a court, a royal, and four thousand households camped along the river. It also has a Tang army coming down the north road. The two men argue about it in front of everyone, because a revival has no rooms with doors.
[7] Geom Mojam: We hold the river. We hold Pyongyang. / If they want it back, they can climb over us.
[8] Anseung: They climbed over Pyongyang two years ago. With better walls than ours in the way.
[9] Geom Mojam: Pyongyang has kings in its soil four hundred years deep. You want to leave them for a Silla guest room?
[10] Anseung: The kings in the soil will keep. The four thousand households above it won’t.
[11] Geom Mojam: Then go. Take your households. / I’ll hold it with whoever stays.
[12] ¶ He says it loud, to the fires. Around the fires, men stop eating. Anseung looks at them. Nobody stands up. Nobody sits down either. He understands what that means before Mojam does. In the morning they will follow whoever is still alive.
[13] Anseung: …You’re right, General. / Let’s sleep on it.
[14] ¶ That night Anseung has him killed in his tent. It is the first Goguryeo blood the revival spills, and it is spilled by Goguryeo.
[15] ¶ In the morning the men by the fires do not ask where the general is. They pack.
[16] ¶ Then he takes four thousand households south, to Silla.
[17] ── SCENE: Silla's Guest ──
[18] ¶ Munmu gives him a title, a district, and a name for the thing: Goguryeo, still standing, inside Silla. It is a useful fiction and both sides know exactly how useful.
[19] ¶ Silla settles him in a town that was somebody else's kingdom ten years ago. Within the year he is called King of Goguryeo. In time he gets a bride, and a seat at Munmu's feasts. Well below the king's.
[20] King Munmu: A king of Goguryeo in Silla. The emperor will hate it. / Good. Give him a seal. A big one.
[21] King Munmu: And end the patent the way the emperor ends his. “Be reverent.” / Twice. He’ll hate that most of all.
[22] ¶ Anseung bows when the seal comes, very low: a king of Goguryeo in a Silla hall. Far north, on the Taedong, a tent is still standing with nobody in it.
[23] ¶ **The emperor hears there is a king of Goguryeo in Silla. His general reaches for a brush instead of a sword…!**
